description: Use when you need every game whose published call is FLAG or WATCH, including domes. Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. Returns those games. For an outdoor kick-time checklist before Sunday lock, use get_sunday_lock_sheet.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.
